title: add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add curated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, a set of tool-calling quickstarts, and corresponding docs site/content updates to make it faster for developers to onboard RAG workflows. Motivation: reduce friction for building agents that combine retrieval + LLM tool-calling, provide vetted templates for common patterns (faq-bot, knowledge-assistant, summarizer with citation), and surface examples on the docs site. Included: agent templates (redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates/*), tool-calling quickstarts (redwood-examples/quickstarts/tool-calling/*), new docs pages and sidebars (redwood-docs/site/content/guides/rag.md, quickstarts/tool-calling.md), updated code samples in JS/Python, and a small E2E smoke harness for the examples. Checklist: [x] templates added, [x] quickstarts added, [x] docs pages written, [x] examples linted, [x] docs preview passes. Testing: local unit tests for examples, manual walk-through on docs preview, and CI docs-preview verification. Rollout plan: merge to main, verify docs preview on staging, cherrypick to release/* if required. See Linear ENG-4921 for acceptance criteria and PM-230 for docs copy.
commits: feat: add rag agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts
docs: add RAG guide and quickstart pages

test: add smoke harness for examples
